results.fact: Which way to go at the Rampart Ridge junction (Rampart Lakes boulder gully vs the Lila Lake side)
results.correct_value: At the ridge-top junction above Rachel Lake, go RIGHT toward Lila Lake (left goes to Rampart Lakes); about 0.3 mi on, a cairn marks a fork where Lila Lake is straight ahead and the climbers' path up Alta's south ridge branches left.
results.evidence: The trail association's hike description: at the ridge the left trail goes to Rampart Lakes, 'you want the trail to the right, to Lila Lake'; after 0.3 mi a cairned junction, Lila Lake straight ahead, the climbers' path to Alta on the left, steep and loose at first then a knife-edge ridge. An independent 2015-era forum trip report agrees: at the ridge junction Lila Lake and Alta are to the right and Rampart Lakes to the left, with the Alta cutoff spurring off before Lila. The row's own beta (cairned climbers' path at the Rachel/Lila junction) and partner_requirements (the easy-to-miss Lila Lake/Alta junction) already agree; the approach, approach variant, saddle waypoint, climbing_route, summit directions, descent_text and itinerary sent parties south through the Rampart Lakes basin to a boulder gully and a 5,570 ft saddle, which is the outlier. The renamed turnoff pin keeps its (estimated) coordinate; its elevation and distance are cleared rather than computed, since no source gives them.
